markets.title: Will the President sign more than 4 Executive Orders between Nov 22, 2026 and Nov 28, 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If the President signs above 4 executive orders during Nov 22, 2026 to Nov 28, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

markets.title: Will there be at least 6 presidential nominations sent to the Senate in the week of Nov 22, 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has sent at least 6 nominations to the U.S. Senate from Nov 22, 2026 through Nov 28, 2026 (as checked on the “Presidential Actions” page at whitehouse.gov before 10:00 AM ET on Nov 29, 2026), then the market resolves to Yes.

markets.title: Will Trump do anything on Nov 21, 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has taken any presidential actions on Nov 21, 2026 (as checked on the “Presidential Actions” page at whitehouse.gov at 10:00 AM ET on Nov 22, 2026), then the market resolves to Yes.

markets.title: Will Mamdani sign above 0 executive orders between Nov 22, 2026 and Nov 28, 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If the number of non-emergency executive orders signed by Zohran Mamdani is above 0 from Nov 22, 2026 to Nov 28, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

markets.title: Will the number of distinct days with a Getty Images editorial photo of Trump be exactly 7 between Nov 23, 2026 and Nov 29, 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If the number of distinct days Donald Trump is photographed in a tagged editorial photo on Getty Images between Nov 23, 2026 and Nov 29, 2026 is exactly 7, then the market resolves to Yes.

markets.title: Will there be at least 9 presidential actions in the week of Nov 22, 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has taken at least 9 presidential actions from Nov 22, 2026 through Nov 28, 2026 (as shown on the “Presidential Actions” page at whitehouse.gov by 10:00 AM ET on Nov 29, 2026), then the market resolves to Yes.

markets.title: Will Trump do anything on Feb 28, 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has taken any presidential actions on Feb 28, 2026 (as checked on the “Presidential Actions” page at whitehouse.gov at 10:00 AM ET on Mar 1, 2026), then the market resolves to Yes.
